examples.text: Para encariñar y retener a un hombre, se recomienda a las mujeres introducir medallas entre el relleno de la almohada.

senses.definition_en: to get attached to, to grow fond of, to become fond of (usually accompanied by con)

examples.english: Sometimes goblins become attached to a house, which they want to enjoy all to themselves. They then bother the tenants until they move out, leaving them in peace once they've achieved their goal.
examples.ref: 1915, Julio Vicuña Cifuentes, Mitos y Supersticiones Recogidos de la Tradición Oral Chilena, page 53:
examples.text: A veces los Duendes se encariñan con una casa, de cuya posesión quieren disfrutar solos. Entonces molestan a los inquilinos hasta conseguir que se muden, dejándolos en paz en cuanto logran su objeto.
examples.translation: Sometimes goblins become attached to a house, which they want to enjoy all to themselves. They then bother the tenants until they move out, leaving them in peace once they've achieved their goal.
